component.name: Twitch Live to Discord
component.summary: Twitch live alerts for labelled Discord webhooks

description.p: A local dashboard and monitor that posts Twitch live alerts to one or more labelled Discord webhooks. No bot, OAuth, or Twitch API registration is required.
Supports multiple streamers and destinations, per-destination and per-route templates, scoped mentions, filters, stream-end cleanup, and encrypted webhook secrets.
